acceptance: candidate and integrate check the destination path and branch before creating anything and exit with a clear message naming them.
A failure after the branch is created removes what the command created.
A refresh test covers an existing destination path.
description: Running 'python -m downstream.refresh candidate --tag v30.31.0 --path ../sqlglot.refresh-candidate --branch refresh/candidate-30.31.0' (the MAINTAINING.md example path) in a clean clone, while ../sqlglot.refresh-candidate already held an older candidate worktree, ended in an unhandled subprocess.CalledProcessError from 'git worktree add' (exit 128). The branch refresh/candidate-30.31.0 was left behind at the tag commit, so a rerun fails on the existing branch. MAINTAINING.md says auto refuses to start, removing nothing, when its branch or work directory exists; candidate and integrate have no such pre-check.
